The '''Ottethan system''' in the [[Ottethan Empire]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ottethan/Legends|Ottethan]].
